metadata.note: VM rehearsal of the MSI GE63 Raider 8SG as msi-ge63.json declares it in the personal config repo: the same 2GiB ESP, LUKS swap sized for hibernation and encrypted btrfs root with the ten-subvolume layout as config/vm-p14s-hibernate.json, PLUS everything that makes this machine Intel-with-an-Optimus-NVIDIA rather than an AMD ThinkPad — intel_pstate on the cmdline, the intel-ucode initrd (and only that one), thermald, the snd_hda_intel quirk, a pam.d/sudo with no fingerprint line, and the hybrid intel+nvidia driver set. What a VM CANNOT prove is stated in scripts/vmtest/guest-ge63.sh: this host is a Ryzen, so intel_pstate cannot bind, and there is no GPU behind the nvidia packages. Public test passphrase 'hibpass' on both volumes; unlock_fido2 is false here and 2 on the real machine (systemd-cryptenroll runs with check=True, so enrolling a key that is not plugged in aborts the apply). Autologins root over serial. NOT for real hardware.

files.content:
# Managed by dasik. Mirrors the real machine: closing the lid suspends and
# then hibernates, which only works because the swap is LUKS with a persistent
# key.
[Login]
HandleLidSwitch=suspend-then-hibernate
HandleLidSwitchExternalPower=suspend

# Managed by dasik. The GE63 Raider 8SG shares its codec with the GE75 Raider
# 8SX: without this quirk the speakers lose their LFEs and headphones are muted
# on plug-in. https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/MSI_GE75_Raider_8SX#Driver_options
options snd_hda_intel model=lenovo-y530

#%PAM-1.0
# Managed by dasik. Vendor file (sudo package) + YubiKey. NO pam_fprintd line:
# this machine has no fingerprint reader, which also takes CVE-2024-37408 off
# the table. pam_u2f reads ~/.config/Yubico/u2f_keys; absent, it just fails and
# the stack falls through to the password.
auth       sufficient  pam_u2f.so cue
auth       include     system-auth
account    include     system-auth
session    include     system-auth
session    optional    pam_systemd.so class=none

# Managed by dasik. Keep the NVIDIA modules OUT of the initramfs: hostonly
# dracut pulls in the drivers for the hardware it sees, and early KMS has no
# access to NVreg_TemporaryFilePath (/var/tmp), which breaks hibernation.
# omit_drivers wins over add_drivers/force_drivers.
omit_drivers+=" nvidia nvidia_modeset nvidia_uvm nvidia_drm "
